name: Swiss AHV and BVG pensions received in Germany
workings: Germany taxes both (treaty Art. 18). Born 1965; both started in 2030, at 65
AHV: like a statutory pension, 86% for 2030; the exempt 14% fixed in 2031: 2,800.00
BVG: the mandatory 60% (18,000) like a statutory pension (exempt 2,520.00); the other 40% (12,000) at the Ertragsanteil for 65, 18%: 2,160
KVdR: comparable foreign pensions at half the rate, 8.75% × 50,000 = 4,375.00; care 4.2% = 2,100.00
